description:
Produce the committed pre-cutover BCH throughput baseline that later non-regression evidence compares against.

## Background

Criterion BCH benches already exist (`crates/gf2-coding/benches/bch_parallel.rs`, `crates/gf2-coding/benches/batch_operations.rs`); what is missing is a pinned baseline: a committed receipt of their results on a suitable uncontended host at a recorded revision, before the BCH surface is reworked. This issue previously claimed the suite needed creating; that premise is stale.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: A committed receipt under `dev/bench_results/` records the existing BCH encode and decode Criterion results at a pinned git revision, with host, toolchain, seeds, and invocation recorded per the repository benchmark-receipt conventions.
- [hard] REQ-02: The receipt names the exact benchmark IDs measured so a later run can compare like for like.
title: Pin the pre-cutover BCH throughput baseline receipt
